description: This is a Java entity class representing an insurance claim within the insurance management system. It defines the Claim entity with fields like reference, customer policy, created by user, claim amount, description, status, timestamps, and relationships to claim status history items.

classes.name: Claim
classes.description: Entity class modeling an insurance claim with fields, relationships, and lifecycle callback for updates.

methods.name: setCustomerPolicy
methods.description: Associates a customer policy with this claim.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who created the claim.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who created the claim.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the user who is the customer for this claim.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer user for this claim.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the claim.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the claim.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the claim.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the claim.

methods.name: getStatusHistory
methods.description: Returns the set of status history entries.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: JPA lifecycle callback to update the 'updatedAt' timestamp before persistence updates.
